articles.title: Broken Bodies, Fresh Faces. India Reshuffles Its ODI Squad as England Series Looms.
articles.excerpt: Harshit Rana's hamstring rules him out of the three-match series. Prince Yadav gets the call-up. And after a 4-0 T20I whitewash, the big guns — Rohit, Kohli, Bumrah — are back.
articles.image_caption: Shubman Gill, India's ODI captain for the England series
articles.nri_angle: Rohit, Kohli, and Bumrah return for the England ODI series — appointment viewing for NRIs worldwide, with the opener on the same day as the World Cup semifinal.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cricket Comes to the Bay. MLC's Playoffs Head to Oakland for the First Time.
articles.excerpt: San Francisco Unicorns top the table, four teams are through, and the league's championship stage moves to the West Coast. For Indian Americans in the Bay Area, live cricket has never been closer.
articles.image_caption: Rashid Khan, who plays for San Francisco Unicorns in MLC 2026
articles.nri_angle: MLC playoffs come to Oakland — live cricket in the Bay Area, home to one of America's largest Indian-American communities. Saurabh Netravalkar and IPL stars make it personal.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Stage Is Set. Bellingham's England Meets Messi's Argentina in the World Cup's Defining Week.
articles.excerpt: Saturday's quarterfinals delivered two extra-time thrillers in Miami and Kansas City. Now the last four convene in Dallas and Atlanta — and NRIs in those cities are already scrambling for tickets.
articles.image_caption: Jude Bellingham celebrates after scoring for England at the 2026 World Cup
articles.nri_angle: Both World Cup semifinals are in US cities with massive Indian-American populations — Dallas and Atlanta — making this a once-in-a-generation chance for NRIs to witness football's biggest stage in person.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Unveils 29 International Sporting Events in Two Years as Ahmedabad's Olympic Dream Takes Shape.
articles.excerpt: With the 2030 Commonwealth Games already locked in and bids live for both the 2036 Olympics and 2038 Asian Games, India is building a sports-hosting machine — and the diaspora stands to gain the most.
articles.image_caption: The Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, the world's largest cricket ground and centrepiece of India's 2036 Olympic bid
articles.nri_angle: An Olympics in India would let NRIs combine a trip home with attending the Games — at a fraction of the cost of a European or Asian Olympics — and amplify India's global sporting identity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Buttler's Brutal 131 Seals the Humiliation. England Whitewash India 4-0 in T20Is.
articles.excerpt: The T20 World Champions failed to win a single completed match on tour. England become the world's number-one ranked T20I side.
articles.image_caption: Jos Buttler smashed 131 off 64 balls in the 5th T20I at Southampton
articles.nri_angle: NRI cricket fans are grappling with their World Champions' worst-ever overseas T20I tour — six straight losses across Ireland and England — while England's number-one ranking means the power balance in white-ball cricket has shifted decisively.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Making History, Then Making a Statement. India's Women Take Lord's Apart on Day Two.
articles.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana's 83, Deepti Sharma's 57, and a commanding second-innings lead of 269 have turned Lord's first-ever women's Test into India's coronation.
articles.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana scored 83 in India's first innings at Lord's
articles.nri_angle: NRI families in the UK packed Lord's for the venue's first-ever women's Test — and watched India's women dismantle the hosts, turning a historic occasion into a statement of cricketing dominance that resonates across the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Glasgow Calls. India Sends 124 Athletes to the Commonwealth Games — But Without Its Medal Machines.
articles.excerpt: No cricket, no badminton, no wrestling, no hockey. With nine of its strongest sports axed from the programme, India heads to Glasgow with a leaner squad, bigger questions, and Neeraj Chopra's fitness on everyone's mind.
articles.image_caption: Neeraj Chopra, India's Olympic javelin champion, whose conditional inclusion headlines the Glasgow-bound squad
articles.nri_angle: Glasgow's large South Asian community gives NRIs front-row access to Indian athletes at the CWG, while India's 2030 hosting bid makes this squad's performance a matter of national sporting ambition.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Three Teams. Four Points. One Playoff Spot. MLC's Brutal Bottom-Half Battle Enters Its Final Week.
articles.excerpt: San Francisco's Unicorns have run away with the league. Below them, Seattle, Texas, and Washington are tied on four points each — and at least one will not survive.
articles.image_caption: Quinton de Kock, captain of the league-leading San Francisco Unicorns in MLC Season 4
articles.nri_angle: MLC is the only major T20 league where Indian Americans can attend world-class cricket live in US cities — and the playoff race's final week offers the best reason yet to show up.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Super Saturday Is Here: Haaland Takes On Kane in Miami, Messi Faces Switzerland in Kansas City
articles.excerpt: Two World Cup quarterfinals on American soil, four Golden Boot contenders, and a semifinal blockbuster already locked in. Here is what NRIs need to know about the biggest day of the tournament.
articles.image_caption: Erling Haaland, who has scored 7 goals in 4 World Cup matches, leads Norway into Saturday's quarterfinal against England in Miami (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Both World Cup quarterfinals are on US soil in Miami and Kansas City, giving NRIs a chance to attend or watch at community gatherings across diaspora hubs from Edison to Fremont.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Knight Riders Finally Crack the Code: LA Hands League-Leading SF Unicorns Their First MLC Defeat
articles.excerpt: A back-to-back surge from the LA Knight Riders — wins over Washington Freedom and the previously unbeaten San Francisco Unicorns — has injected life into the MLC Season 4 race.
articles.image_caption: Andre Russell, one of the LA Knight Riders' star all-rounders in MLC Season 4
articles.nri_angle: MLC is the only professional cricket league where NRIs can attend live T20 matches in American cities — the standings race directly shapes the diaspora's summer sports calendar.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Merino Does It Again. Spain's Late Hero Sinks Belgium to Set Up a Semifinal Showdown With France.
articles.excerpt: Mikel Merino's 87th-minute winner at SoFi Stadium breaks Belgium's hearts and ends Spain's record-breaking shutout streak in style.
articles.image_caption: Mikel Merino in Spain's national team colors, the hero of two knockout-round winners at the 2026 World Cup
articles.nri_angle: The World Cup quarterfinal was played at SoFi Stadium near LA's Little India, and the semifinal heads to Dallas — home to one of America's largest South Asian communities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Four Wickets. Four Balls. Shanaka's Last-Over Miracle Writes the Wildest Chapter in MLC History.
articles.excerpt: Sri Lanka's Dasun Shanaka becomes the first bowler to take a double hat-trick in Major League Cricket, defending 15 runs in the final over for the Seattle Orcas.
articles.image_caption: Aerial view of the Knight Riders Cricket Field in Pomona, California, where Shanaka's historic double hat-trick unfolded
articles.nri_angle: MLC's fourth season is being played in cities with large NRI populations — Pomona, Redmond, New York — and Shanaka's viral moment is the kind of cricket highlight shared across diaspora WhatsApp groups.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: World Champion Gukesh Headlines India's Strongest Chess Tournament as Chennai Rolls Out the Red Carpet.
articles.excerpt: The Quantbox Chennai Grand Masters returns for its fourth edition with a ₹75 lakh prize pool, a field featuring Gukesh, Erigaisi, Firouzja, and Niemann, and FIDE Circuit points on the line.
articles.image_caption: Reigning World Chess Champion D. Gukesh, who headlines the 2026 Quantbox Chennai Grand Masters field
articles.nri_angle: India's chess golden age — with Gukesh as world champion, Pragg winning Norway Chess, and multiple top-10 players — is inspiring a wave of young Indian American chess players across the US.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cricket Diplomacy. Australia's Big Bash League to Open Its Next Season in Chennai.
articles.excerpt: PM Modi and PM Albanese jointly announced that Melbourne Renegades will face Perth Scorchers at Chepauk on December 12 — the first time any foreign domestic cricket league plays an official match in India.
articles.image_caption: MA Chidambaram Stadium (Chepauk) in Chennai before an India vs Australia ODI
articles.nri_angle: The BBL's Chennai debut bridges two cricket worlds NRIs have straddled — the sport's expansion beyond the IPL validates the diaspora's dual cricket identity in Australia and India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drawing Board Time. BCCI Orders Performance Review After India's Record T20I Losing Streak.
articles.excerpt: Five consecutive defeats — two against Ireland, three against England — have triggered the board's first formal scrutiny of Gautam Gambhir's coaching tenure. The 'reset' has become a reckoning.
articles.image_caption: India head coach Gautam Gambhir at a cricket event
articles.nri_angle: India's record T20I losing streak has deflated NRI cricket communities that celebrated the World Cup win just months ago, raising urgent questions about the team's post-triumph direction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Two Overs and Done. Ashwin's MLC Dream Ends as Knee Betrays Him Again.
articles.excerpt: The first Indian international to play in Major League Cricket managed just 12 balls for the San Francisco Unicorns before a recurring knee injury forced him out. Peter Siddle, 41, takes his place.
articles.image_caption: Ravichandran Ashwin receiving the Arjuna Award in New Delhi
articles.nri_angle: Ashwin was the first Indian international to join MLC — the US-based cricket league NRIs actually attend. His one-match exit is a setback for the league's Indian talent pipeline and Bay Area cricket fans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Five Losses in a Row. England Seal Their First-Ever T20 Series Win Over India.
articles.excerpt: Harry Brook's 79 off 35 balls and Phil Salt's unbeaten 59 power England to a nine-wicket win at Bristol. Shreyas Iyer's lone 80 not out cannot save India from a record-extending collapse.
articles.image_caption: Harry Brook in action for England
articles.nri_angle: India's record five-match T20 losing streak and the omission of World Cup hero Sanju Samson are dominating NRI cricket debates from the Bay Area to the Tri-State area.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dada Enters the Pantheon. Sourav Ganguly Inducted Into ICC Hall of Fame.
articles.excerpt: The former India captain becomes the 10th Indian men's cricketer in cricket's most exclusive club. Sachin Tendulkar's tribute: 'This wasn't a surprise.' A Rajkummar Rao biopic was unveiled the same day.
articles.image_caption: Sourav Ganguly, former India captain and newly inducted ICC Hall of Fame member
articles.nri_angle: Ganguly's fearless captaincy defined how a generation of NRIs see Indian cricket — his Lord's celebration and refusal to back down became symbols of a new Indian confidence that resonated far beyond the boundary.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mbappe's Eighth Goal Sends France Past Morocco and Into the World Cup Semifinals.
articles.excerpt: Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele score in the second half as France eliminate Morocco 2-0 in Foxborough. Les Bleus await the winner of Spain vs. Belgium in the last four.
articles.image_caption: France celebrate their quarterfinal victory at the 2026 FIFA World Cup
articles.nri_angle: With all quarterfinals and semifinals on American soil and in American time zones, NRI watch parties from Edison to Fremont are turning this World Cup into the most accessible global football event in diaspora history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 212 Years of Lord's. Zero Women's Tests. Until Friday.
articles.excerpt: England and India will play the first-ever women's Test at the Home of Cricket, 50 years after Rachael Heyhoe-Flint led the first women's match at the ground.
articles.image_caption: Lord's Cricket Ground in London, set to host its first women's Test match in its 212-year history (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: The first women's Test at Lord's gives NRIs in the UK a historic chance to watch India's women at cricket's most iconic venue, correcting a 212-year exclusion.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cricket's Mr. 360 Goes to Baseball. Suryakumar Yadav Named MLB's First Indian Ambassador.
articles.excerpt: India's T20 World Cup-winning captain will attend All-Star Week in Philadelphia, as Major League Baseball bets big on the world's largest cricket-loving market.
articles.image_caption: Suryakumar Yadav, India's T20 World Cup-winning captain, named MLB's newest global ambassador
articles.nri_angle: India's cricket captain bridging the gap between cricket and baseball gives NRIs in America official representation at the highest level of both bat-and-ball sports.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: America's Cricket League Has a Runaway Leader. San Francisco's Unicorns Are the Team to Beat.
articles.excerpt: With five wins from eight matches and a four-point cushion at the top, the Unicorns are turning Major League Cricket's fourth season into a one-horse race.
articles.image_caption: Cricket action at a Major League Cricket venue in the United States
articles.nri_angle: MLC is the only major cricket league NRIs in the US can attend in person and watch in their own time zone, making it uniquely accessible for diaspora fans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Eight Teams. Four Cities. Three Days. The World Cup Quarterfinals Are Here.
articles.excerpt: France face Morocco in a semifinal rematch today in Boston, while Spain, Argentina, England, Belgium, Norway, and Switzerland battle for semifinal spots across three host cities through Saturday.
articles.image_caption: France's Kylian Mbappé during their Round of 16 match against Paraguay at Philadelphia Stadium
articles.nri_angle: All quarterfinal matches are being played in US cities with large Indian-origin communities, from Boston to Los Angeles to Miami to Kansas City — this World Cup is in the diaspora's backyard.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Series Lost. Pride on the Line. India's Last Stand Against England Begins in Bristol.
articles.excerpt: India trail 0-2 after the humiliating 76 all out at Trent Bridge. The fourth T20I at Bristol's County Ground today is a must-win to keep the series alive — and the Sanju Samson debate rages on.
articles.image_caption: India captain Shreyas Iyer faces mounting pressure after three consecutive T20I defeats on the UK tour
articles.nri_angle: For the large Indian diaspora in Britain and NRIs across the US, this painful tour — 0-2 down with the world number one T20I ranking at stake — has been must-watch despite the heartbreak.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Messi in Tears After Argentina's Three-Goal Comeback Stuns Egypt in 13 Frantic Minutes
articles.excerpt: Trailing 2-0 with 11 minutes left, the defending champions score three — Romero, Messi, Fernandez in stoppage time — to survive the round of 16 and reach the World Cup quarterfinals
articles.image_caption: Lionel Messi celebrates after scoring Argentina's equaliser against Egypt in Atlanta
articles.nri_angle: The World Cup quarterfinals are being played across US cities — LA, Miami, Kansas City, Foxborough — bringing the drama to NRI doorsteps
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seventy-Six All Out. Archer and Tongue Rip Through India for England's Biggest-Ever T20 Win.
articles.excerpt: World champions bowled out in 11.4 overs — their lowest total in 18 years and heaviest defeat in T20I history — as England seize a 2-0 series lead with two to play
articles.image_caption: Jofra Archer, who took 3-29 to dismantle India's top order at Trent Bridge
articles.nri_angle: India's humiliating T20I defeat raises concern among diaspora cricket fans, especially as England threaten to overtake India's No. 1 T20I ranking
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Twenty Goals. Thirty-Nine Years Old. Messi Faces Salah in Atlanta With a Quarterfinal Spot on the Line.
articles.excerpt: The final day of the World Cup's Round of 16 brings the tournament's biggest showdown yet — and completes the quarterfinal bracket that stretches from Foxborough to Miami.
articles.image_caption: Lionel Messi in Argentina colors at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar
articles.nri_angle: Millions of NRIs across the US can watch the World Cup's marquee matchups in their host cities — from Atlanta to Vancouver to LA — as football fever grips the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Belgium's Tactical Brilliance Overwhelms USA in Seattle Showdown
articles.excerpt: Belgium defeats USA 4-1 in front of a packed Lumen Field, securing their spot in the World Cup quarter-finals.
articles.image_caption: Lumen Field in Seattle, WA — venue for USA vs Belgium at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Seattle's large Indian-American community added a vibrant cultural dimension to the World Cup match atmosphere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Spain Edges Portugal as Mikel Merino's Late Strike Sends Iberian Rivals Packing
articles.excerpt: Mikel Merino's stoppage-time goal propels Spain past Portugal in a tense Round of 16 clash.
articles.image_caption: AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX — venue for Portugal vs Spain at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: The Indian-American community in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, one of the largest in the U.S., embraced the World Cup with enthusiasm, adding a vibrant cultural layer to the match atmosphere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: World Cup Day 26: Belgium beat USA 4-1; Spain beat Portugal 1-0
articles.excerpt: Group stage action from Seattle, WA, Arlington, TX on July 06 — 2 matches, no shortage of drama.
articles.image_caption: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Day 26 recap
articles.nri_angle: World Cup matches in US cities near major NRI communities. 0 of today's 2 matches were in cities with large Indian-American populations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Haaland Scores Twice. Neymar Says Goodbye. Norway End Brazil's World Cup Dream at MetLife.
articles.excerpt: The Manchester City striker headed in the opener and fired an unstoppable second as Norway reached the quarterfinals for the first time. Brazil haven't made the last eight since 1990.
articles.image_caption: Erling Haaland celebrates after scoring his seventh World Cup goal against Brazil at MetLife Stadium
articles.nri_angle: NRI fans packed MetLife Stadium in New Jersey's Indian diaspora heartland to witness one of the biggest World Cup upsets in history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Trail 1-0. Bishnoi's 29-Run Over Still Stings. Trent Bridge on Tuesday Is Do-or-Die.
articles.excerpt: England's shortest boundaries, India's youngest debutant, and a series that threatens to slip away before it's even half done. Here's everything at stake in the 3rd T20I.
articles.image_caption: Trent Bridge cricket ground in Nottingham, venue for the crucial 3rd T20I between England and India
articles.nri_angle: With the series slipping away, NRI cricket fans in the UK face a crucial midweek fixture while US-based fans can catch the action on Willow TV at lunchtime.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
